card.name: Last word of an organization or program name
card.fires_on: The last word or final piece of a name for a program, office, or initiative (e.g. Water Conservation, REMS, IPM) that is followed by a noun like Program, Line, or CME.

modes.label: Program name ending
modes.description: The final piece of an acronym or program title just before a noun such as Program or CME.
modes.example: a list of accredited REM<<S>> CME/CE, call 8

modes.label: Government or agency unit name
modes.description: A word inside the name of a public office, service line, or partner body.
modes.example: call the City of Santa Rosa Water<< Conservation>> Information Line @ 543.

modes.label: Anniversary or event title
modes.description: A word in the title of a commemorative event or program.
modes.example: the Glacier Cent<<ennial>> Program hosted a film festival
